verdict: Meta has been dark since August 6; campaigns are being reactivated now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 34 leads entirely from Meta at a cost of $24.71 per lead — all of that activity came before August 6, when Meta spend stopped. Seventeen consecutive zero-spend days have run through this week, meaning no new leads have been generated since then. Website sessions fell 32% over the past 7 days compared to the prior 7, which is consistent with paid traffic being off and is not a separate tracking issue. Of the 34 leads that did arrive earlier in the period, none have moved into the intake pipeline as open opportunities, so that conversion step is being addressed alongside the reactivation. Campaigns are being brought back on this week, and the pipeline follow-up process is being tightened to ensure new leads are worked when volume resumes.
